Introduction

O-24 (Korean: 오투포) was a three-member girl group under Yeum Entertainment (formerly Eunsung Entertainment & Init Entertainment). They made their debut on November 30, 1998 with the studio album Live In Hip Hop. Their group name means 'to think of hip hop from 0 o'clock to 24 o'clock'.
